args.content: Correction: the 'billing window' definition has changed. This supersedes the prior definition (Q2 2025, April-June). Apply this corrected definition whenever an analysis refers to the 'billing window' — it scopes queries against memory.bench.orders (and derived revenue aggregates like memory.bench.daily_region_revenue) to Q4 2025.
